Hello there,

I'm working on a Taric rework which I'll share later next week. I'd like to know what players specifically dislike or like about him. Yes, he's boring and his kit isn't very original, but he's a legacy character. A lot of old school players have a soft sport for them and don't want reworks to stray away too much from the champion's original design. I personally wish to propose a hard rework which only keeps the concept of the champion, e.g. heal, ability which gives allies armor, ability which deals damage based on armor, some form of CC.

Any bit of feedback is greatly appreciated.

I always liked the combination of his armor aura and how his passive knocks time off of his spell CDs. It makes it so that whenever you're facing a taric, you never do as much damage as you think you will, and you're consistently taking more than you're expecting because of his shred.

Also, if you can get the right rhythm down between healing, stunning, etc, and successfully chain his passive without OOMing yourself, he actually does a pretty crazy amount of damage.

EDIT: He's almost like a sustained version of Leona. I don't mean 'sustain' as in 'heals his lane parter', though... Like how Leona is really good at getting all over her opponents, but only when her abilities are up, Taric is constantly all over his opponents, and his lack of "burst cc" kinda makes up for it.
Taric is one of the last remaining champions with a unit targeted stun. I like having champions in the game with stuns that can't be flashed out of.

Single target offensive abilities in my opinion don't really fit LoL, as they reduce counter play. In a game like Dota, it works out due to different types of balancing and scaling. But I get your point and will think about it.

What if the stun aspect of dazzle worked like the damage aspect? Where the duration of the stun is longer the less distance it has to travel to hit an opponent? That way it could still be targeted, but also make positioning more important. Y'know, if he hits it at max range, then it's gonna stun for a very short duration... So it sort of forces Taric to be up in his opponent's face to be effective?

but like half the champions have unit targeted abilities and with the increase in crazy amounts of mobility its hard to counter THAT without unit target moves. Kalista, vayne, lucien, ekko, and ezreal to name a few. Knowing a champ has a unit targeted ability makes the enemy play more cautiously which can be a welcome relief.

I play Taric a lot. He's very reliable and he's easy to pick up. I don't really like his heal when using it on anyone else because its almost not worth mana to cast it, but it will keep him alive in a team fight so I like that aspect.

The biggest problem with Taric IMO is that his ult is so lacklustre. His skit itself is actually pretty underrated imo (which is why he is actually one of the better lane bullies early game) the problem is his ult just offers no real utility. His stun and armor are core, but I think you can get as creative and fabulous as you want with his ultimate and no one will miss it!
I totally agree with this. Hopefully the ult would fit in to the spell rotation, armor boosting, armor shredding, healing kit.

Well, the advantages of his ult are a relatively short cd, free stats, and high base damage. If you use his abilities with the right cadence, you can use his ult like every 15 seconds. It makes him a pretty high damage support, even with like no AD or AP, which is interesting, but... It also leads to him accidentally taking kills with it, which makes ADCs super butthurt.

Just a fun idea:

* Remove damage on stun.

* Remove passive affecting ult.

* Remove ult.

* Ult doubles effectiveness of one ability for a short period of time or 2 - 3 casts. Can have an option menu like Kha's upgrades except the application is instant. If used on R, increases passive to 3 seconds instead of 2.

* Increase base movement speed by 5.

Black Mage here!

If you are a Final Fantasy veteran then forget everything you've learned from previous games. Fire and Ice are stances and elemental weakness isn't a thing here. Fire is your goto damage spell for the entire game (You get Fire 2, 3, and 4 eventually but they have specific uses). Being in the Ice stance (Umbral Ice) recovers your MP then you switch to the fire stance (Astral Fire) And burn the hell out of everything until you have barely no MP left...then switch to ice. If what you're fighting might stick around for a little while hit them with Thunder first...that is your damage over time spell. That's the basics until you start getting more spells.

Not sure where you ended up but I'm on Ultros if by chance you happen to be on that server.

Happy Burning!
